user.title: SolarPool AI - Entity Mapping
user.description: Configure the entities your system will use. The optional sensors allow you to use specific sensors instead of weather entity attributes.

data_description.uv_sensor_id: Use a specific UV sensor (e.g., from PirateWeather) instead of weather attribute
data_description.cloud_coverage_sensor_id: Cloud coverage % to calculate effective UV (UV × (1 - clouds/100))
data_description.wind_sensor_id: Use a specific wind sensor instead of weather attribute
data_description.ambient_temp_sensor_id: Use a specific temperature sensor instead of weather attribute

parameters.title: SolarPool AI - Parameters
parameters.description: Adjust the system parameters according to your setup.

init.title: SolarPool AI - Options
init.description: Modify system parameters. You can also configure optional sensor overrides.

data_description.uv_sensor_id: Use a specific UV sensor instead of weather attribute. Leave empty to use weather data or automatic estimation.
data_description.cloud_coverage_sensor_id: Cloud coverage % to calculate effective UV. With 80% clouds, UV 8 becomes 1.6.
data_description.wind_sensor_id: Use a specific wind sensor instead of weather attribute.
data_description.ambient_temp_sensor_id: Use a specific temperature sensor instead of weather attribute.
